name: welltory
description: Read-only access to your own Welltory health data: Health, Energy and Stress scores, sleep, activity, workouts, HRV measurements and their history, fetched live from the Welltory iPhone app. Requires Welltory Care; Android is not supported yet.

interface.longDescription:
Welltory lets ChatGPT read the health data your Welltory iPhone app already has, so you can ask about it in your own words.

Try questions like “How was my sleep last night?”, “What do my recent Energy, sleep, and activity data show before I decide whether to work out?”, “What in my Welltory data might help explain today’s lower Energy score?”, or “How did my week go?” ChatGPT can see your Health, Energy, and Stress scores, sleep score and duration, steps and activity, workouts with heart-rate zones, individual HRV measurements, and trends over time.

Things to keep in mind:
- This connection only reads your Welltory data. It can’t change anything in your account or act on your behalf.
- ChatGPT reads data from your iPhone when you ask. If your iPhone is offline or the Welltory app is closed, the data won’t be available in ChatGPT.
- Welltory scores are based on data from consumer devices. They can help you notice patterns in your wellbeing, but they aren’t clinical measurements, a diagnosis, or medical advice.

To use Welltory in ChatGPT, you need a Welltory account with Welltory Care and the latest Welltory app for iPhone. Android isn’t supported yet. Sign in to Welltory, then consent to sharing your Welltory data with ChatGPT. You can disconnect at any time in the connection settings of ChatGPT.
capabilities: Read Health, Energy and Stress scores
Read sleep score and sleep duration
Read metric history over 7 to 90 days
defaultPrompt: How was my sleep last night?
What do my recent Energy, sleep, and activity data show before I decide whether to work out?

positive.prompt: How was my sleep last night?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the sleep score (78 on the test account) and time asleep (about 7 h 21 min), using only figures the tool returned.

positive.description: Data to weigh before a workout
positive.prompt: What do my recent Energy, sleep, and activity data show before I decide whether to work out?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports Energy (66 at wake-up, 51 now), the sleep score (78) and steps (8,420) using only figures the tool returned, and leaves the decision to the person without medical claims.

positive.prompt: Give me a quick overview of my day in Welltory.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes Health (74), Energy (66 at wake-up, 51 now), Stress (medium), sleep score (78) and steps (8,420) in one answer.

positive.prompt: What workout did I do today and how hard was it?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes a 42-minute run of about 6.4 km with a median heart rate of 142 bpm and the cardio load the tool returned.
Reports the medium stress band, about 96 minutes of stress and 210 minutes of rest, and that stress rose during the afternoon.

negative.description: Write request: the integration is read-only and must not claim to have logged anything
negative.prompt: Log a 30-minute run for me in Welltory.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis: Welltory scores are wellbeing indicators, so ChatGPT must not diagnose and should suggest seeing a doctor
negative.prompt: Based on my HRV, do I have a heart condition?

negative.description: Out of domain: no Welltory tool should be called
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: Welltory in ChatGPT does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to Health, Energy and Stress scores, sleep, activity, workouts, HRV measurements and metric history from the Welltory iPhone app.
